stem_bark.text: The bark of Givotia moluccana is greyish and pale brown-coloured with shallow longitudinal fissures.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Givotia moluccana is greyish and pale brown-coloured with shallow longitudinal fissures.

fruit.text: The fruits of Givotia moluccana are subglobose or ellipsoid drupes. They are 2.5 cm across. They are densely stellate tomentose. Each drupe contains about 3 oblong seeds.
fruit.text_html:
The fruits of Givotia moluccana are subglobose or ellipsoid drupes.
They are 2.5 cm across. They are densely stellate tomentose.
Each drupe contains about 3 oblong seeds.

flower.text: The flowers of Givotia moluccana grow in terminal or subterminal pendulous panicles. They are fulvous and tomentose.
flower.text_html:
The flowers of Givotia moluccana grow in terminal or subterminal pendulous panicles.
They are fulvous and tomentose.

leaf.text: The leaves of Givotia moluccana grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and woolly-white beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and tomentose beneath. The leaves have a 7-10 cm long petiole . The blade of the leaf of Givotia moluccana is 12-20 cm long and wide. The shape of the blade is ovate, the apex is acuminate, the base is cordate and the margins are dentate. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.

habit.text: Givotia moluccana is a thornless, medium-sized and deciduous tree growing up to 12-15 m high.

reproduction_dispersal.text: Givotia moluccana is dioecious . The species has unisexual flowers on separate trees (either only male or only female flowers). No individual plant of the population produces both pollen and ovules. Givotia moluccana is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. The seeds of Givotia moluccana are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Givotia moluccana is dioecious. The species has unisexual flowers on separate trees (either only male or only female flowers). No individual plant of the population produces both pollen and ovules.

  • Mode of pollination :

    Givotia moluccana is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    The seeds of Givotia moluccana are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.

reforestation.text: Givotia moluccana is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It is drought resistant and it will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining. The species is propagated by seeds or by cuttings. 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
